knownLimitations.detail: Fractional rating Space selection works. Native ArrowRight moves radio focus but leaves Core value2.5 in adapter, official React and Vue on Chromium154. No upstream post.
Zod3 async refinements throw from live safeParse in all3 implementations; submit path is separately async. Evidence records an expected limitation, not full async-refinement support.

Incremental native mask typing and colorpicker aria-valuetext/button violation remain previously peer-reproduced limitations. This run adds caret/token initialization and fixes an adapter-specific grouped-colorpicker lifecycle error; it does not resolve those upstream issues.

Specific mode scenarios, not every prop combination. Max refusal/removal/new values, tag drag, currency boundaries and pointer slider now have additional peer evidence. Arbitrary option/icon slots, slider touch edges and comprehensive accessibility/memory/performance remain broader coverage. No camera/decode path exercised.

An earlier4s slider focus timeout passed isolation and the final33-target run. An invalid initial date token fixture, numeric label fixture, ambiguous label selectors and peer fixture initialization were corrected before final evidence; invalid fixture failures are not reported as new support.
Parent-subtree ownership introduces explicit descendant cleanup scopes; no speed or memory benefit is claimed. Comparative timing, memory and CPU profiling remain held.
